exposure: Maternal migrant status (local women from PRD region, migrant women from Guangdong province, migrant women from other provinces)
cohort: 5,219,133 singleton live births in the Pearl River Delta (PRD) region of China between January 1, 2014, and December 31, 2020
finding: Migrant women from other provinces in China had a lower risk of LBW compared to local women in the PRD region, while local women had the highest prevalence of PTB.
